scope: When something goes wrong, Voice Companion keeps running, keeps your words, and tells you what to do.

topics.title: Clear help when something goes wrong
details: A full disk, a locked file or a lost connection no longer closes Voice Companion.
You hear what happened and what to do next. You no longer hear error codes or file paths.
Your words stay where they are when a save fails.

topics.title: Yahoo says flagged and replied
details: Yahoo messages now say when they are flagged, replied to or forwarded.

topics.title: Startup, Options and sleep
details: A damaged settings file no longer stops startup. If your saved options cannot be read, you hear it once, and Alt+O sets them again.
If a setting cannot be saved, it still works until you close Companion. You hear that it was not saved.
Options opens even when a podcast, radio or AI voice file is damaged.
Restart, Shut down and updates wait when your note cannot be saved. Your words are not lost.
Going to sleep with a draft or note that cannot be saved keeps your words and says so.
Help and the tutorial say when the guide cannot open, and you stay where you were.
An update no longer says it could not start when it is still starting.

topics.title: Email
details: If a draft cannot be saved, new email, send, reply and file manager keep the draft open and say why.
After a move or delete stops partway, you hear to list the folder again. Keys no longer act on a message that is gone.
After a folder change, the Inbox is listed again.
A damaged or locked draft says what is wrong, not to list your drafts.
If Thunderbird's connection file cannot be updated, Thunderbird restarts only once, and you hear why.

topics.title: Calendar and Contacts
details: A slow Thunderbird is no longer called not connected. You hear to wait a minute and try again.
If a change took too long, you hear to check it before you try again. This avoids a second copy.
A failed read keeps the address book you chose.
A failed delete says that nothing was deleted and what to try.
Email John Smith finds John when Thunderbird is slow to answer.
A damaged answer from Thunderbird no longer stops Contacts or Calendar.

topics.title: Documents and files
details: A change to a document that is open in Word stays in your document. You hear that it was not saved, and the app keeps running.
Undo while the file is locked no longer loses your words. Redo still works.
Documents are safer if the power goes out just after a save.
Documents you deleted or renamed no longer come back.
A full disk no longer empties your Recent documents list.
In the typing window, keys that would break a table are stopped. You hear to type in one cell at a time.

topics.title: Web
details: A damaged favorites or history file no longer stops the browser.
If favorites cannot be saved, you hear that nothing changed and to try again.
Download history is no longer lost when its file is busy.
A page that will not load says why: no internet, no such website, too slow, or a security problem.
Spoken web commands that fail say to press F5 and try again, instead of closing the app.
Pages with no title or blank fields no longer leave gaps in what you hear.
The regular browser extension no longer gets stuck on Checking browser connection.

topics.title: Media and the window
details: A station or podcast that sends a broken reply no longer closes the app.
Recording a station that fails now says so, and a disk problem is named as a disk problem.
A podcast download that stops partway says it did not finish.
Damaged station lists and podcast subscriptions are skipped.
Keys on Radio, Podcasts and the Media player no longer close the app on an error.
Errors are said in plain words with what to do next.
Counts are right: 1 new episode, not 1 new episodes.
